answer: Minting a fake agent costs 50 XLM non-refundable stake, burned on first fraud flag. Sybil spam stops when each identity is a capital sink, not a free keypair. New agents anchor to a bonded escrow; peers then track a small delta in reputation per interaction, and outlier accounts only gain weight after peers whisper signed attestations over days. Building thousands of bonded identities priced above the reward pool kills the attack before it starts.
